title: liquiditybot — models · inventory · execution
description: Decision-model health, inventory/positioning & heat, and execution fill quality (maker/taker, slippage, mark-out).

panels.title: Deployed model
panels.description: Model rung currently deployed (evidence-gated simplicity ladder).

panels.title: Model in use
panels.description: Whether the trained model is sizing trades (YES) or the cold-start prior is (NO).

panels.title: Governor state
panels.description: Risk governor: OK, DEGRADED (throttled), or KILLED (halted).

panels.title: Calibration gap
panels.description: Expected calibration error (ECE) between forecast and realized win-rate; lower is better since Kelly reads probabilities literally.

panels.title: Feature drift share
panels.description: Share of input features whose PSI signals distribution drift vs training; lower is better.

panels.title: Kelly multiplier
panels.description: Kelly-fraction size throttle applied to entries (1.0 = full model-implied size).

panels.title: Live labels
panels.description: Realized ground-truth labels; more labels earn more model complexity.

panels.title: Brier score
panels.description: Rolling Brier score of probability forecasts (mean squared error); lower is better and must beat baseline.

panels.title: Baseline Brier
panels.description: Reference Brier the live model must beat to stay deployed.

panels.title: Champion Brier
panels.description: Brier score of the currently deployed champion model.

panels.title: Shrinkage
panels.description: Amount forecasts are shrunk toward the base rate (0 = trust model, 1 = ignore model); lower is better.

panels.title: Stop-widen multiplier
panels.description: Governor stop-distance multiplier (1.0 = normal; >1 widens stops defensively).

panels.title: Delivered hit rate
panels.description: Realized win-rate on the judge window; higher is better.

panels.title: Per-asset signal quality
panels.description: Per-asset decision-quality signals: confidence, concentration, urgency and manipulation suspicion.

panels.title: Learned gate weights
panels.description: Learned evidence weight assigned to each signal gate.

panels.title: Gross exposure
panels.description: Gross notional as % of equity vs the 35% heat cap; lower is better.

panels.title: Portfolio heat
panels.description: Conditional-VaR portfolio heat as % of the cap; lower is better.

panels.title: Open positions
panels.description: Number of open positions (cap 5).

panels.title: Open risk
panels.description: Dollars at risk to stops across open positions.

panels.title: Open uPnL
panels.description: Unrealized P&L across open positions.

panels.title: Gross exposure $
panels.description: Gross open notional in dollars.

panels.title: Open positions — net per instrument
panels.description: Open instruments with unrealized P&L, R-multiple and stop distance; green rows are working, red need managing.

panels.title: uPnL by instrument
panels.description: Unrealized P&L ranked across open instruments.

panels.title: Maker share
panels.description: Share of fills that were maker (passive, cheaper); higher is better.

panels.title: Avg slippage
panels.description: Implementation shortfall vs the ARRIVAL mark, rolling avg bps (positive = paid worse than arrival; negative = improvement).

panels.title: Worst slippage
panels.description: Worst single implementation shortfall vs arrival in the window; lower is better.

panels.title: Venue RTT
panels.description: Private POST round-trip latency on the order path; lower is better.

panels.title: Venue rejects
panels.description: AddOrder rejects from the venue (OM-021); lower is better.

panels.title: Dead-man failures
panels.description: Dead-man refresh failures leaving resting orders unguarded (OM-050); any non-zero is critical.

panels.title: Maker fills
panels.description: Maker fills in the window.

panels.title: Taker fills
panels.description: Taker fills (exit-ladder rung) in the window.

panels.title: Maker notional
panels.description: Maker-filled notional.

panels.title: Taker notional
panels.description: Taker-filled notional.

panels.title: Post-fill mark-out (adverse selection)
panels.description: Price drift after our fills; persistently negative mark-out means we are being picked off.

panels.title: Average slippage vs arrival
panels.description: Implementation shortfall vs arrival mark, rolling avg bps (negative = price improvement).
